changes.title: We’re Taking Hobbies Too Far
changes.summary: —Mitch Diamond—Getty Images A few weeks ago, a clip from Dominican Sisters Open Mic , a podcast featuring Catholic nuns, went viral. “Do you have a hobby, sister?” one nun asks the other. “I do not have a hobby,” the nun replied, noting that a “hobby, to me, feels like just something else to do.” That must be freeing.
